final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg FROM group_averages), with_overall AS (SELECT ga.transref, ga.group_avg, ga.group_avg - oa.overall_avg as diff_overall FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND ga.group_avg > oa.overall_avg), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as final_avg FROM with_overall), with_final AS (SELECT wo.transref, wo.group_avg, wo.diff_overall, wo.group_avg - fa.final_avg as diff_final FROM with_overall wo CROSS JOIN final_average fa WHERE fa.final_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT transref, group_avg, diff_overall, diff_final FROM with_final ORDER BY CASE WHEN diff_final IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, diff_final DESC LIMIT 10
